signature.name: VTask.linearMapOfLE
signature.type: (𝕜 : Type u_1) -> {α : Type u_3} -> (E : α → Type u_4) -> [(i : α) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] -> [NormedRing 𝕜] -> [(i : α) → Module 𝕜 (E i)] -> [∀ (i : α), IsBoundedSMul 𝕜 (E i)] -> {p q : ENNReal} -> (h : p ≤ q) -> ↥(lp E p) →ₗ[𝕜] ↥(lp E q)

conventions.statement: For any f : lp E p, coercing VTask.linearMapOfLE 𝕜 E h f to a function gives the same function as coercing f directly: the inclusion does not alter values.
conventions.note: This is the defining convention that the map is the identity on underlying data.
